newsitem.title: FRANCE: French car sector trade surplus widens in Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: French car sector trade surplus widens in Jan-Aug.

text.p: The French car industry recorded a trade surplus of 21.07 billion francs in the first eight months of the year, up from 19.74 billion in the comparable 1995 period, the French carmakers' association CCFA said on Monday.
The surplus was generated almost entirely by the auto components sector, which recorded a 22.74 billion surplus in January-August, up from 20.25 billion for the same period last year.
The truck and bus sector recorded a 3.48 billion deficit, down from four billion in 1995, while the car sector showed a surplus narrowing to 1.01 billion francs from 3.09 billion.
The trade surplus in used cars and used car parts widened to 800 million francs from 410 million.
Total industry exports in the first eight months of 1996 rose to 120.58 billion francs from 111.69 billion, while imports totalled 99.51 billion francs, down from 91.95 billion.
